nosotros.introText1: Founded by Dominican guides, we connect travelers from around the world with the real island.
nosotros.introText2: No middlemen, no massive crowds. Every tour is designed to give you something you won't find in any conventional travel catalog: the island that Dominicans actually live.
nosotros.step1Desc: Browse the catalog, use the interactive map, filter by zone or activity. Find the tour that speaks to you.
nosotros.step2Desc: Choose your date, fill out the form. Only 20% deposit required. Immediate confirmation by email.
nosotros.step3Desc: We pick you up at your hotel at the agreed time. We handle the rest. You just live the moment.
nosotros.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before booking.
nosotros.faq1Q: How does the booking process work?
nosotros.faq1A: Simple: choose your tour, select the date, and fill out the form. We only ask for a 20% deposit to confirm. The balance is paid on the day of the tour directly with your guide.
nosotros.faq2A: Door-to-door transport from your hotel, certified bilingual guide, activity insurance, and all required equipment for each tour. Specific details are listed on each tour page.
nosotros.faq3A: Yes, free cancellation up to 48 hours before. In cases of force majeure we reschedule at no extra cost. If the new date doesn't work, we refund your deposit in full.
nosotros.faq4Q: Do you accept children? Is there a discount for minors?
nosotros.faq4A: Most of our tours accept children. The minimum age varies by activity (shown on each tour). Prices for children under 12 are significantly lower.
nosotros.faq5Q: In what languages are tours conducted?
nosotros.faq5A: Spanish and English on all guaranteed tours. Some tours also in French and German upon request. Note it in your booking and we'll assign the right guide.
nosotros.faq6Q: How do I get to the departure point?
nosotros.faq6A: You don't need to worry — transport is included. We confirm your hotel pickup time 24h before the tour via WhatsApp.
nosotros.faq7Q: What if the weather doesn't cooperate?
nosotros.faq7A: Safety is our absolute priority. If conditions aren't suitable, we reschedule at no cost. If you can't make the new date, we refund your deposit in full.
nosotros.faq8Q: What payment methods do you accept?
nosotros.faq8A: The 20% deposit is paid online with Visa, Mastercard, or PayPal. The remaining balance on the day of the tour in cash (USD or DOP), card, or transfer. No extra charges.
nosotros.faq9Q: Do you offer private tours for groups?
nosotros.faq9A: Yes! For groups of 8 or more we offer exclusive tours with a private guide and fully flexible schedule. Message us on WhatsApp for a personalized quote in under 2 hours.
